author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: LILYGO has introduced the T-SIM / T-A Standard Series, a refreshed family of ESP32-S3 cellular development boards combining SIMCom and A76xx modem options with new hardware features including Qwiic support, seamless power switching, camera interfaces, optional GNSS functionality, and lower deep-sleep power consumption. title: LILYGO adds ESP32-S3 Standard Series to T-SIM lineup

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Following the Rockchip RK3572 announcement, Forlinx Embedded has introduced the FET3572-C SoM and accompanying OK3572-C development board. The platform combines an octa-core CPU configuration, 4 TOPS NPU, LPDDR5/LPDDR5X support, and multimedia capabilities extending to 8K decoding. title: Forlinx rolls out FET3572-C SoM and OK3572-C board with Rockchip RK3572
